articles.title: Ranveer Allahbadia hails Diljit Dosanjh after Wembley milestone: ‘The whole of India should be standing and applauding this man’
articles.summary: Diljit Dosanjh continues to expand his global footprint, with his recent performance at London’s Wembley Stadium becoming another major milestone in h.
articles.body: Diljit Dosanjh continues to expand his global footprint, with his recent performance at London’s Wembley Stadium becoming another major milestone in his international career. The Punjabi singer-actor performed before a crowd of nearly 90,000 on September 12 as part of his Aura World Tour. Reacting to the achievement, Ranveer Allahbadia praised Diljit for taking Indian music to international audiences and described his journey as an example of what humility, faith and hard work can achieve.Ranveer Allahbadia calls Diljit’s Wembley performance a moment of prideIn a video shared on Instagram, Ranveer Allahbadia spoke about the significance of Diljit headlining one of the world’s most recognised stadiums. He noted that Wembley has hosted some of the biggest names in international music, including Taylor Swift, Beyonce, Harry Styles and Michael Jackson, and highlighted Diljit’s entry into that league of performers.“The whole of India should be standing and applauding this man,” Ranveer said while reflecting on Diljit’s journey from Punjabi entertainment to becoming an internationally recognised artiste.Diljit made history with the Wembley concert as the first Punjabi artiste to headline the iconic London venue. For Ranveer, the achievement represents more than just a successful concert, as he believes it reflects the growing international reach of Indian artistes.Ranveer compares Wembley milestone with Bollywood box-office numbersRanveer also questioned why large achievements in live music do not always receive the same attention as blockbuster film collections. Drawing a comparison with the way Bollywood celebrates major box-office figures, he pointed out the scale of Diljit’s Wembley audience.“We celebrate 100 crore films so much,” he said, stressing that selling 90,000 tickets for a concert at one of the world’s most prominent stadiums is itself a significant commercial and cultural achievement.He further said that Diljit’s journey could eventually be remembered as one of the notable artistic success stories of the post-Independence era. “This is proof of what humility, faith and sheer hard work can build in one lifetime,” Ranveer said.He concluded his tribute by thanking Diljit for his contribution to Indian music’s international presence and for “taking India to the world.”Diljit performs popular tracks and pays tribute to Nusrat Fateh Ali KhanDiljit’s Wembley set featured several of his popular songs, including “GOAT”, “Lover”, “Hass Hass” and “Born to Shine”. He also performed “Sanson Ki Mala Pe” as a tribute to legendary Pakistani musician Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan. Videos from the performance have since gained significant attention online.For Diljit, the Wembley concert was equally meaningful. The singer has described the show as a dream come true and thanked his fans after the performance, calling it the beginning of a new chapter.From Coachella to Wembley, Diljit’s international journeyThe Wembley achievement adds to a series of international milestones in Diljit Dosanjh’s career. In 2023, he became the first Punjabi artiste to perform at Coachella. The following year, he made his debut on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon and also became the first South Asian artiste to feature on the cover of Billboard magazine.With each of these milestones, Diljit has continued to take Punjabi music and Indian popular culture to audiences beyond the country. His Wembley performance now stands as another significant moment in that journey, earning praise from Ranveer Allahbadia and attention from fans across India and abroad.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.body: MS Raju’s latest film ‘Agadha’, which released on the silver screens on August 14 is now gearing up for a digital release. The film which is a mystic thriller that features Kamakshi Bhaskarla in the female lead will be hitting the OTT world next week.‘Agadha’ OTT release dateThe movie will begin streaming on ZEE5 from September 25.About ‘Agadha’The film received a mixed response during its theatrical run and stars Kamakshi Bhaskarla in the lead role. It shows Kamakshi Bhaskarla plays Mahadevi, a spiritually gifted woman whose life changes after a series of unexplained deaths and the mysterious suicide of her cousin.Her search for answers takes her into a forbidden forest cave, where she encounters a supernatural presence known as Agadha. What begins as an attempt to understand the strange events slowly turns into a journey involving faith, fear, mystery and the unknown.Cast of ‘Agadha’Talking about the cast, Shravan Reddy and Ulka Gupta play important roles, while Jovika Vijay Kumar, Roshan Basheer, Bhanu Chander and Vanitha Vijayakumar are also part of the team.The film has a combination of supernatural and spiritual elements with its central mystery. Kamakshi carries the story through Mahadevi’s personal journey, which also serves as the emotional centre of the film.‘Agadha’ box office collectionAccording to trade analyst Sacnilk, the film has minted over Rs 1.44 crore during its total gross collection and made a total India net collection of Rs 1.30 crore.MS Raju, who started his career as a producer before turning director, has directed ‘Agadha’. articles.title: Varun Dhawan, David Dhawan REACT after Salman Khan defends him against trolls; Neha Dhupia says, 'Tiger zinda hai'
articles.summary: Varun Dhawan and his father, filmmaker David Dhawan, have responded after Salman Khan came out in support of Varun on the latest 'Weekend Ka Vaar' epi.
articles.body: Varun Dhawan and his father, filmmaker David Dhawan, have responded after Salman Khan came out in support of Varun on the latest 'Weekend Ka Vaar' episode of 'Bigg Boss 20'. The host spoke against online trolls who make fun of celebrities for how they look and also took on photographers who click actors from awkward angles.Salman Khan speaks up for Varun Dhawan and Sohail KhanWhile speaking about the kind of comments stars get on social media, Salman Khan brought up his brother Sohail Khan and Varun Dhawan. He explained that showing care about an actor's health is very different from laughing at the way they look. Salman stated, "Showing concern that bhai, you look unwell, you have lost weight, is different. But mocking Sohail and Varun over their looks? That is wrong."Varun Dhawan and David Dhawan reactThe remarks seemed to strike a chord with Varun Dhawan and David Dhawan, who later reacted to the moment. Varun shared a video of his father's reaction and added a "clap" emoji. The clip was recorded while 'Bigg Boss 20' was on air, at the point when Salman took off his shirt on television.Salman removes shirt to challenge trollsOn stage, Salman took off his hat and shirt and asked people who have been trolling him over his weight and appearance to take a look at him now. He declared, "Bhai mota hogaya hai, bhai ko troll karo… Karlo troll, yeh lo. Karlo troll. Aao, troll karna hai na? Troll karna pasand hai? Yeh dekho, close-up karlo (Salman has put on weight; go ahead and troll him... Go on, troll away—here you go. Troll him. Come on, you want to troll, right? You enjoy trolling? Look at this, get a close-up)."Salman Khan calls out paparazziSalman also spoke against photographers who click actors from angles that make them uncomfortable, particularly from behind. He questioned why such pictures are taken and how they are then presented on social media. Speaking about the practice, Salman said, "And then the one shot they take from behind, which none of the heroines like? There must be a few who say it's okay, I don't mind it. But what about those who don't like it?"He recalled seeing several actresses handle such situations and said, "I recently saw Saiee Manjrekar was so awkward with that. Neha Dhupia fought against it. My own niece, she was walking, and they kept clicking from behind. And what did the caption say? Guess who it is. Who are they to do this?"Salman urged women who are uncomfortable with such photographs to speak up instead of putting up with them. "I am saying this to all the girls who don't like this. Jahan aisa hua, ghoom ke chamaat maaro. Bolna na apni maa behenon ka yeh shot lete ja, aur humko dikha. (When such a thing happens, just turn around and slap them. Ask them to click their mother or sister like this and show it to you). Disgusting people. They do this all the time at every function," shared an angry Salman.Neha Dhupia respondsNeha Dhupia, whom Salman Khan named during his speech, reacted on social media on Sunday afternoon. She wrote, "Tiger… zinda hai …"More about Salman KhanOn the work front, Salman Khan will next feature in Vamshi Paidipally's film, tentatively titled 'Monster', co-starring Nayanthara.Varun Dhawan's projectsVarun Dhawan will next star in 'Bhediya 2' and reportedly a horror flick backed by Aditya Chopra's production house.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Serie A: Milan vs. Lecce – probable line-ups, where to watch on TV
articles.summary: Christian Pulisic is set to make his first Milan start of the season as the Rossoneri look to get back to winning ways against Lecce and snap a three-game wi...
articles.body:
Christian Pulisic is set to make his first Milan start of the season as the Rossoneri look to get back to winning ways against Lecce and snap a three-game winless run.

It kicks off at 20:45 CET [19:45 BST] at the Stadio Meazza (San Siro), Milan, right after Juventus-Atalanta.

GENOA, ITALY – MAY 17: Christian Pulisic of Milan looks on during the Serie A match between Genoa CFC and AC Milan at Stadio Luigi Ferraris on May 17, 2026 in Genoa, Italy. (Photo by Simone Arveda/Getty Images)

Milan can rely on a full squad, except for Warren Bondo , who isn't on their Serie A list.

According to Sky Sport and Gazzetta, Adrien Rabiot will return to the starting XI in central midfield; the other spot will go to either Yunus Musah or Luka Modric , with the Croat currently the favourite.

MILAN, ITALY – AUGUST 28: Adrien Rabiot of Milan on the ball under pressure from Antoine Hainaut of Venezia during the Serie A match between AC Milan and Venezia FC at Stadio Giuseppe Meazza on August 28, 2026 in Milan, Italy. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images)

Pulisic is set to start his first game this season after making two substitute appearances against Lazio and Benfica in the last two games.

According to Sky and Gazzetta, Alexis Saelemaekers will be the other attacking midfielder, so Alphadjo Cissé will start on the bench.

SASSUOLO , ITALY – MAY 17: Eusebio Di Francesco, Head Coach of US Lecce , looks on prior to the Serie A match between US Sassuolo Calcio and US Lecce at Mapei Stadium Citta del Tricolore on May 17, 2026 in Sassuolo, Italy. (Photo by Alessandro Sabattini/Getty Images)

Lecce are without Willem Geubbels , Hjalte Laerke, Omri Gandelman and Medon Berisha .

The match is available on TNT Sports 1, DAZN and HBO Max in the UK and Ireland and on Paramount+ in the USA. Football Italia will provide live updates via this LIVE BLOG here .

Milan (3-4-2-1): Maignan ; Gila, De Winter , Pavlovic; Chukwueze , Modric, Rabiot, Estupinan; Saelemaekers, Pulisic; Ramos.

Lecce (4-3-3): Falcone; Danilo Veiga , Tiago Gabriel , Siebert, Gallo; Maleh , Ilic, Coulibaly; Monteiro, Stulic, N'Dri.
